## Description {#details}

The <code>math</code> namespace offers a suite of constexpr mathematical function templates and utilities for use within the µTest++ framework.

These functions include generic implementations for absolute value, minimum value, exponentiation, and compile-time parsing of numeric values from character arrays. The utilities are designed to be lightweight and suitable for embedded environments, where standard library alternatives may be unavailable, less efficient, or not constexpr.

All definitions within this namespace are intended to facilitate mathematical operations in a type-safe and efficient manner, and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
